candidate.title: Fixed templated CRD installation in the `base` chart by default
candidate.text: Fixed templated CRD installation in the `base` chart by default. Previously this only worked under certain conditions, and when certain install flags were used, could result in CRDs that could only be upgraded via manual `kubectl` intervention. Deprecated `Values.base.enableCRDTemplates`. This option now defaults to `true` and will be removed in a future release. Until then, the legacy behavior can be enabled by setting this to `false`

evidence.excerpt:
- |
  **Fixed** templated CRD installation in the `base` chart by default. Previously this only worked under certain conditions,
  and when certain install flags were used, could result in CRDs that could only be upgraded via manual `kubectl` intervention.
  **Deprecated** `Values.base.enableCRDTemplates`. This option now defaults to `true` and will be removed
  in a future release. Until then, the legacy behavior can be enabled by setting this to `false`

issue: Istio-base helm chart does not apply CRDs with correct app, chart, and release labels [closed; labels area/user experience, lifecycle/staleproof, area/upgrade]
### Bug Description

Hi,

Deploying istio/base chart via Helm (with base.enableCRDTemplates set to "true") make CRDs be applied by following manifests :
https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/master/manifests/charts/base/crds/

Issue is that when you want to redeploy those CRDs (when some of them have new features, in my case EnvoyFilter getting "priority" spec, included in istiod since 1.14) via Helm, I got an error saying that the…
